北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京天气晴朗，体感 3℃，记得多穿点，注意补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels like 3℃. Remember to dress warmly and stay hydrated!
北京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 4℃，出门别忘添衣，小心着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 4℃. Remember to add layers when going out and avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴沉，体感 4℃，气温较低，保暖是关键哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels like 4℃. It's chilly, keeping warm is key!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，体感舒适，湿度稍高，记得保持愉快心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy with a comfortable 16℃. Humidity is a bit high, stay cheerful!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 17℃，气温适中，注意通风，保持舒适。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 17℃. The temperature is moderate, keep well-ventilated and comfy.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 4℃，有点湿冷，穿暖和再出门哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 4℃, a bit damp and cold. Dress warmly before heading out!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阳光虽好，体感 3℃，外出要注意防寒保暖哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny but feels like 3℃. Remember to keep warm and protect against the cold when out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 9℃，注意适时添衣，以免受凉。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 9℃. Remember to add clothes as needed to avoid catching a cold.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾弥漫，体感 3℃，出行注意安全，保暖！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels like 3℃. Be careful when traveling, stay warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 6℃，风干物燥，记得多喝水滋润。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 6℃. It's dry, remember to drink more water to stay hydrated.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 11℃，湿度较高，保持衣物干爽。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 11℃. Humidity is high, keep your clothes dry and comfortable.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -15℃，冻人！全副武装，暖暖出门。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -15℃, it's freezing! Bundle up completely and stay warm outside.
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 1℃，天冷干燥，多添衣物勤补水。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like 1℃. It's cold and dry, add more clothes and drink plenty of water.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，体感 18℃，但湿度低，多喝水润润喉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels like 18℃. Humidity is low, drink more water to soothe your throat.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 9℃，风大湿冷，注意防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 9℃ with a level 3 wind. It's windy and damp-cold, remember to shield from wind and stay warm.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 1℃，湿冷明显，注意防寒，别着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like 1℃. It's noticeably damp and cold, keep warm and don't catch a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴好，体感 2℃，天干物燥，注意添衣和保湿哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like 2℃. It's dry, remember to add clothes and moisturize.
